title: Ballot record, version 4 (two panels, naming its cell): encodings, admission checks, intake admission at a seat of either panel, and decode rejections
generator: packages/crypto/scripts/ballot-v4-records-vectors.py, an implementation of the Ballot record (version 4) section and of intake's admission steps (share-encryption.md, Intake and receipts; Ballot version 4) with Python's integers and hashlib, reusing this folder's independent ballot-v2, ballot-v3, ballot-v4, membership, revoting and definition-v6 generators; cell trees built by ballot-v2-vectors.py from each tier's groups; membership proofs by packages/crypto/scripts/ballot-proofs.mjs, run outside the workspace with Semaphore 4.14.3's depth-32 circuit artifacts and snarkjs 0.7.5's fullProve, which checks that each proof's outputs equal the root and nullifier computed here; every pairing verdict is snarkjs's groth16.verify on the signals derived here from the record and the definition. Share hashes are labels, not ciphertext hashes (version 4's ciphertexts are P2-16 part 2b-3's). Decode errors and their offsets are labelled by hand from the strict-decoding rules and the layout's offsets
